ety.text: Coined by Étienne Geoffroy Saint-Hilaire in 1818 as épi- + sternal. The prefix is from Ancient Greek ἐπί (epí, “on top of”), in reference to its position as the anteriormost pair of bones in Geoffroy Saint-Hilaire's proposed nine-bone model of the vertebrate sternum.
